data.name: Litlip
data.detailed_description:
• Litlip is a retro-style single-player adventure game in which you have to change several characters throughout an unusual plot, explore a colorful world and collect important items for the story.

  • The gameplay combines exploration, quest elements and a leisurely pace, ideal for those who just want to relax and enjoy the atmosphere. Litlip is a no—rush game where you can experience every moment and explore every corner.

  • A special feature of the project is a non—standard approach to storytelling: a series of games is told in the order of "middle — beginning — end". This allows you to immediately immerse yourself in the essence of events, and then step by step reveal the secrets of the world and the characters. This style helps to feel the plot more deeply and look at it from different angles.

data.short_description: Litlip is a retro-style game where players change characters, explore the world, and collect plot-essential items. It’s a relaxing and fun experience. The game series follows a unique “Middle-Beginning-End” narrative structure, which I believe works best.
